candidate_relations.reason: Maffucci syndrome (enchondromas plus venous malformations) is a different vascular-skeletal syndrome.
Capillary malformation–AVM syndrome is a related capillary-malformation disorder with incompatible genetics versus concurrent MIC-CAP and Mowat-Wilson.
Sturge-Weber syndrome requires facial port-wine stain with leptomeningeal angioma, not this pattern.
Congenital heart disease requiring neonatal surgery is a component/associated malformation, not the dual syndrome diagnosis.
Brain-specific angiopathy is not a defined equivalent of MIC-CAP plus Mowat-Wilson.
Neurofibromatosis type 1 is a different neurocutaneous syndrome.
Aicardi syndrome is an X-linked female-infantile spasm disorder, not this capillary-malformation/microcephaly composite.
Coagulation and platelet function were normal, so a primary bleeding disorder is not the diagnosis.
Developmental delay is a manifestation of the dual developmental syndromes.
Hereditary hemorrhagic telangiectasia is a related epistaxis/vascular syndrome with incompatible features versus MIC-CAP/MWS.
Ollier disease is multiple enchondromas without this neurodevelopmental/capillary phenotype.
Parkes Weber syndrome is a fast-flow limb overgrowth disorder.
Osler-Weber-Rendu is HHT, a conflicting vascular-malformation syndrome.
PHACE syndrome is a segmental facial hemangioma spectrum, not MIC-CAP plus Mowat-Wilson.
Ehlers-Danlos syndrome is a connective-tissue disorder, not this dual genetic syndrome.
Gorlin syndrome is a basal-cell nevus syndrome, not microcephaly-capillary malformation plus MWS.
Neurocutaneous disorder is a broad parent missing concurrent MIC-CAP and Mowat-Wilson.
Klippel-Trenaunay-Weber syndrome is a slow-flow limb overgrowth syndrome.
